name: propose
title_zh: 仓库改完自动起草团队上下文变更提案
tagline_zh: 别等周会才想起上下文已过期。它扫一遍真实 diff，替你写成能直接讨论的提案，省掉你从零回忆和措辞的那半小时。
tagline_en: Don't wait for the weekly to find context gone stale. It scans real diffs and drafts a discussable proposal.
desc_en: Draft a change proposal to the team context from what actually changed in this repository.
why_zh: 提案不是从你的记忆里挤出来的，而是从仓库实际变化里长出来的——先看 diff 再说话。
why_en: The proposal grows from actual repo changes, not your memory—diff-first, so discussions stay grounded in what really happened.
limit_zh: 只覆盖代码与配置变更，不读 issue、PR 讨论或设计文档；产物是提案草稿，不含投票或决策记录。
limit_en: Only covers code/config diffs, not issues, PR threads, or design docs. Output is a draft proposal, no voting or decision log. Useless if team.
title_en: Draft a team-context change proposal from what actually.
